run_reward_model_training: run reward modeling training on a pretrained sequence classification model with a HuggingFace dataset
run_reward_model_lora: run reward modeling training with LoRA PEFT fine-tuning on a sequence classification model
run_reward_model_quantized: run reward modeling training with 4-bit or 8-bit quantization on a pretrained language model
run_reward_model_evaluation: run reward model evaluation and save metrics after training on a test dataset split
run_reward_model_push_hub: run reward model training and push the saved model to the HuggingFace Hub
